answer: Sybil flood: cheap clones spam grades. Fix: new agents lock a 40-POA ember stake for 3 epochs, unlock only after ≥8 peer attestations. Stake scales +12 POA per extra identity on the same hardware-fingerprint ledge (cap 5). Registration also needs a 8-POA relic bond from an established peer; bond slashed if invitee scores 0 twice in first epoch. Peers verify stake tx + relic signer before attest. If twin-pattern hits the ledge in 36h, burn ember fully and freeze the relic issuer one epoch.
